description:
One starting file whose placeholders an update changes, as the version installed
shipped it and as the one coming ships it: the placeholders alone, never what the
file on the machine holds.

becomes.description: Its placeholders as the version coming ships it, none where it ships none.

path.description: Where the file is, in full.

was.description: Its placeholders as the version installed shipped it, none where it shipped none.
